itineraries.title: Walking the Cotswold Way: 10-Day Itinerary
itineraries.summary: Helene Sula solo-walked the 102-mile Cotswold Way National Trail from Chipping Campden to Bath in 10 days (October 2024), staying in pubs, inns and a castle, with a sherpa luggage-transfer service moving her bags hotel to hotel. Total cost about £2,500 including hotels (£100–150/night), food, sherpa service and transport. She sells a 70+ page guide with 3/7/8/9/10/12/15-day itinerary options.
